claim: Any JSON under the declared evidence path was exempted even when it was not part of the actual canonical record set.
evidence: A configs/critical.json change after source_revision passed check-records --repo when configs was declared as evidence_path.
impact: Unreviewed configuration could alter behavior while bypassing source and worktree checks.
required_action: Exempt only the actual records directory and exact content-hashed evidence files.

prevention.action: Compare evidence_path with the actual records directory and only exempt canonical JSON from that directory.
